episode.title: The First Signal
episode.description: A voice from the railway. A missing night. Three people who remember it differently.
character.anisha.name: Anisha
character.anisha.bio: A night-shift photographer who heard a signal where the old railway disappears into the trees.
character.rafi.name: Rafi
character.rafi.bio: A railway maintenance apprentice who knows which lines were supposed to be dead.
character.mira.name: Mira
character.mira.bio: Anisha's closest friend. She has been avoiding one question since the night the signal began.
chat.anisha.day01.003: I found something strange near the railway line.
post.anisha.001.body: I heard a strange signal near the old railway line last night.
minigame.signal_sequence.title: Reconstruct the Signal
minigame.signal_sequence.instructions: Repeat the signal pattern in the correct order.
minigame.signal_sequence.hint: Listen for the alternating low and high tones.
chat.rafi.001: Anisha said you might contact me. Before you ask: no train has used that line in eleven years.
chat.rafi.002: But the signal box logged a power draw at 02:17. I checked it myself. The meter was physically warm.
choice.rafi.003.prompt: Why were you checking an abandoned signal box?
choice.rafi.003.trust: I believe you. Show me what you found.
choice.rafi.003.challenge: You expect me to believe a warm meter proves anything?
chat.rafi.004: Then look at the maintenance record. Someone signed the inspection under a name that doesn't exist.
chat.rafi.005: Fair. It doesn't prove a ghost train. It proves someone had access and wanted the log to look ordinary.
chat.rafi.006: There was a second mark beneath the fresh paint: three short lines, one long, then three short again. Same rhythm as the signal.
chat.rafi.007: I sent the pattern to Mira. She stopped replying the moment she saw it.
chat.mira.001: Rafi should not have sent you that pattern.
chat.mira.002: I was there the night the railway lights went out. Anisha remembers the noise. I remember someone calling my name from inside the locked station.
choice.mira.003.prompt: What do you want me to do with the location you found?
choice.mira.003.send: I'll send it. We need to know what's there.
choice.mira.003.keep: Not yet. We don't know who is listening.
chat.mira.004: Then meet us at the service gate before sunrise. Don't use the main road.
chat.mira.005: You're right. Keep it off the chat for now. I'll find another way to get us inside.
chat.mira.006: One more thing. The voice on the signal wasn't asking for help. It was repeating a name.
notification.signal.title: A new lead
notification.signal.body: The first signal has been traced. The investigation is no longer a coincidence.
